assets.prompt: Create a production-ready 2D JRPG dialogue-stage background, landscape 1536x1024. A close, intimate meeting spot where two rural dirt paths join under large green trees on the way to a nearby town. NO characters, NO cart, NO luggage; these will be separate game sprites. Camera: side-on three-quarter RPG diorama, only slightly looking down, NOT overhead map, NOT vast aerial landscape. Large tree trunks and foliage cropped at left/right/top, a few small rocks and grass tufts at the edges. An open broad ochre dirt path across the lower 45% of the image, with flat unobstructed staging ground at y=76%; shrubs and the fork recede behind it. The intended chibi characters will be 24% of image height; grass beside their feet should be ankle height, stones shoe height, tree trunks much taller than people. Rich carefully hand-painted PIXEL ART with clearly readable pixel clusters, warm sun-dappled woodland, muted moss green and honey-brown palette, dark brown outlines on foreground objects, crisp detail similar to polished chibi fantasy game sprites. No tiny town, no river, no bridge, no tent, no houses, no signpost, no text, no UI, no grid. This is a finished game environment, not a concept sheet. Balanced gentle warm daylight from upper left. Keep the central 70% staging floor clean and visually quiet.

Create a polished game sprite of ONE heavily loaded small medieval two-wheel wooden HANDCART, three-quarter SIDE VIEW, front/pulling end points RIGHT. Transparent background with real alpha, full cart isolated with padding all around, no ground, no people, no animal. Hand-painted PIXEL ART matching a detailed cute chibi JRPG: crisp brown outlines, warm wooden planks, iron wheel rims, large wooden spokes, chunky readable pixel clusters, sunlight from upper left. The cart bed is stuffed with village trade goods: three wooden crates of different sizes, two bulging tied linen sacks, a wicker produce basket secured under rope. In addition visibly excessive 'just in case' travel supplies tied outside and on top: TWO rolled rain cloths (muted teal and cream), a neatly coiled spare rope, three small empty drawstring herb pouches hanging on the near side, a strapped leather satchel. Cargo should look well secured and practical but comically more than expected, highest sacks above an imagined chibi person's head. Real believable construction: exactly two wheels on one axle, two long parallel draw shafts extending RIGHT, accessible shafts ending at a person's waist, solid stable load. Side angle is only mildly looking down, approximately 15 degrees, so wheels read almost circular; NOT top down and NOT steep isometric. Design for showing at 200 px wide: broad clear object groups and good silhouettes, not tiny busy grain or photorealism. No text, no labels, no coins, no magic, no rectangular placeholder graphics. Horizontal 1536x1024 output, object fully visible without clipping including both shafts. The cart occupies most of the frame.

One compact bundle of village trade goods for a chibi JRPG traveler: a medium soft olive-green cloth-wrapped parcel with tied cream cord, with a small tan leather shoulder pouch leaning against it. Isolated game prop sprite on REAL TRANSPARENT background. The pair sits tightly together as ONE small piece of hand luggage, no cart, no person, no backdrop, no platform, no text. Side-on three-quarter view slightly looking down 15 degrees, polished hand-painted pixel-art, warm brown outlines and readable pixel clusters, same aesthetic as cute detailed fantasy JRPG chibi sprite characters. The cloth bulges naturally around contents and has nice folds, cord loops and knot; leather pouch has a flap and simple brass buckle. Warm soft light from upper left. Not a rectangle, not a box icon, not simplistic vector art. At game size the full bundle should be about a character's knee height. Leave generous transparent padding, all visible.
